senses.gloss:
प्रउग प्र-üग, अम्, n. (according to the
commentators fr. प्र-युग), Ved. the forepart of
the pole or shafts of a chariot (Sāy. = ईषयोर् अग्रं
युग-बन्धन-स्थानम्); उभयतः-प्रüग,
having the foreparts of the shafts on both sides; (अस्,
अम्), m. n., N. of the second Śastra or hymn at
the morning libation.
—प्रüग-चित्, त्, त्, त्, Ved.
arranged in the form of the forepart of a chariot-pole.
